name: connect
description: Connecti monorepo for the fullstack project

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w @connecti/api" "npm run dev:socket -w @connecti/api" "npm run dev -w @connecti/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @connecti/shared && npm run build -w @connecti/api && npm run build -w @connecti/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @connecti/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
